name: AHU units
tagline: Fresh air, filtration and conditioning in one
description: Air handling units that condition and distribute fresh air with filtration, cooling, and ventilation control.
long_description: An AHU draws in return and fresh air, filters it, passes it over chilled-water or DX coils, and blows it through ductwork to the building. Modular sections can add pre-filters, fine filters, heat recovery and humidity control. AHUs are central to indoor air quality in hospitals, offices, malls and clean environments.
features: Multi-stage filtration for cleaner indoor air
Chilled-water or DX cooling coil options
Modular sections built to suit the site

specs.label: Filtration
specs.value: Pre-filter, fine filter; HEPA for clean areas

specs.label: Fan
specs.value: Belt-driven or direct-drive EC / plug fans

specs.label: Options
specs.value: Heat recovery wheel, UV, humidity control, VFD

variants.suits: Single floors, clinics and small offices
Pre-cooled fresh air for VRF or FCU systems

considerations: Size airflow from the heat load and the fresh-air needs of the space
Clean areas such as OTs need HEPA filtration and pressure control
Leave access space around the AHU for filter changes and coil cleaning

faqs.question: AHU or fan coil unit?
faqs.answer: AHUs handle large zones and fresh air through ductwork. FCUs are smaller, room-level units that run off the same chilled-water system.

faqs.question: Do you clean and service AHUs?
faqs.answer: Yes. We change filters, clean coils, service belts and bearings, and check drains as part of an AMC.
